title: Moisture, Water Activity, Drying Uniformity, and Rate Workbook
purpose: Support defensible measurement of moisture content, water activity, equilibration, air/product conditions, airflow distribution, and drying-rate behavior.

sections.title: Moisture Content and Water Activity Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Are moisture content and water activity both measured and interpreted as distinct properties?

sections.title: Moisture Sorption and Equilibration Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Has the sample reached a defensible equilibrium state, and does its moisture history matter to interpretation?

sections.title: Air and Product Condition Map
sections.decisionPrompt: Do product and air conditions reveal transition or condensation risk that room RH alone would miss?

sections.title: Drying Uniformity Map
sections.decisionPrompt: Which locations dry slowest or fastest, and what airflow/loading feature explains the pattern?

sections.title: Drying Curve and Rate Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the time series show normal progression, a stall, or an excessive rate requiring intervention?

qualityRules: Record basis, temperature, equilibration, and instrument identity for moisture/aW data.
Preserve time-series data rather than endpoint-only records.
Map spatial variation instead of assuming room uniformity.
Document all interventions on the same timeline as measurement changes.
